queries:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) AS b FROM signals
),
grp AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod
  FROM signals
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
kept AS (
  SELECT rfistat, avg_mod
  FROM grp, base
  WHERE avg_mod > base.b
)
SELECT
  k.rfistat AS rfistat,
  k.avg_mod AS avg_modindex,
  k.avg_mod - base.b AS diff_from_baseline,
  k.avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM kept) AS diff_from_kept_mean
FROM kept k, base;
SELECT CASE WHEN rfistat IS NULL OR TRIM(rfistat) = '' THEN 'No Status' ELSE rfistat END AS rfistat,
       COUNT(*) AS signal_count
FROM signals
GROUP BY CASE WHEN rfistat IS NULL OR TRIM(rfistat) = '' THEN 'No Status' ELSE rfistat END;
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(rfistat, 'Unknown'), 'No Status') AS rfistat, COUNT(*) AS signal_count
FROM signals
GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(rfistat, 'Unknown'), 'No Status');
SELECT signalregistry FROM signals WHERE modindex > (SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL);
